note: Project-code prefix -> the recipients that use it. Most prefixes name one recipient. LCC is the only genuine collision: Limerick's prefix, also printed on Louth's provisional 2022 codes, so it lists both and a heading always decides. A prefix with one candidate can attribute a row whose section heading is missing; a prefix with several cannot, and such a row is withheld rather than guessed.

LCC.note: Louth's provisional 2022 codes are printed LCC/22/xxxx; the section heading decides.
